statements.text: When AMD trades at its all-time high in the middle of a breakout on rising volume, the price rose in 90 % of 10 independent cases within 5 trading days.
After a fall of 20 % from its all-time high, AMD came back every time: in all 9 cases since 2016 the old high was reached again within 24 months at most.
After a fall of 40 % from its all-time high, AMD came back every time: in all 3 cases since 2016 the old high was reached again within 21 months at most.
